resolved.title: 二维数组
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Two-Dimensional Arrays[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A [b]two-dimensional array[/b] is an array of arrays and can be thought of as a table. You can also think of a two-dimensional array as a grid for representing a chess board, city blocks, and much more. 

A two-dimensional array declaration indicates the number of number rows and the number of columns. 
[s0l0!-header][b]For example: [/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="c" ]int a[2][3]; /* A 2 x 3 array */ [/code]
Nested curly braces are used to initialize elements row by row, as in the following statement: [code format="c" ]int a[2][3] = {
  {3, 2, 6},
  {4, 5, 20}
}; [/code]
The same statement can also take the form: [code format="c" ]int a[2][3] = { {3, 2, 6}, {4, 5, 20} }; [/code]
The former statement offers more clarity with visualizing the structure of the array.
[note]An array can have more than two dimensions. For example, a[5][3][4] is an array that has 5 elements that each store 3 elements that each store 4 elements.[/note]
